ValidationRule.description: This rule requires that a product status is required prior to saving the lead record. This rule is specific to the MCA product status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( And( ISBLANK( FPC_Rep_MCA__c ),NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT( Status_MCA__c )))), AND( NOT(ISBLANK( FPC_Rep_MCA__c )),ISBLANK(TEXT( Status_MCA__c ))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If FPC Rep MCA is populated the Status MCA is required.
